Backend Developer

We are hiring a Backend Developer to design and scale the APIs that power our logistics platform, which handles millions of shipment events per day.

What you'll do
- Design and implement scalable REST APIs and background services
- Model data and optimize queries in PostgreSQL
- Implement caching with Redis and asynchronous processing with Kafka or RabbitMQ
- Own authentication and authorization flows (OAuth2, JWT)
- Improve reliability through monitoring, logging and alerting
- Participate in on-call and incident reviews

Requirements
- 2+ years of experience building backend services
- Strong proficiency in Python (Django, Flask or FastAPI) or Node.js
- Solid understanding of SQL, database design and indexing
- Experience with Docker and deploying services on AWS
- Knowledge of microservices and distributed system fundamentals
- Experience writing automated tests

Preferred
- Experience with Kubernetes and Terraform
- Familiarity with system design for high-throughput systems
